component.name: OLED Wallpaper
component.summary: Interactive animated galaxy wallpaper for OLED displays

description.p: OLED Wallpaper renders a living galaxy scene optimized for OLED and AMOLED panels. True-black backgrounds maximize contrast and prevent burn-in, while a rich set of interactive features turns your desktop into a dynamic space simulation.

ul.li: Binary star system with realistic gravitational dynamics
Kepler orbital mechanics — planets follow elliptical orbits around the primary star
Oort cloud of procedurally generated comets and debris
Randomized meteor showers with glowing trails
Left-click panning to explore the galaxy
Right-click pulse effects that ripple through the star field
OLED burn-in prevention via slow scene drift and pixel-shifting

description.p: Initial release featuring binary star system, Kepler orbits, Oort cloud, meteor showers, and interactive panning and pulse effects.
